feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: Oregon governor Tina Kotek reacts to Silver Rail Elementary school shooting
entry.summary: NPR's Joel Rose talks with Oregon Governor Tina Kotek about the shooting at Silver Rail Elementary in Bend, Oregon.

entry.title: Iowa's vote in midterms may help determine balance of power in Congress
entry.summary: Iowa Public Radio's Natalie Krebs reports on how Iowa - a state that reliably votes Republican for president - has some competitive races for Republicans in November, which could help determine the balance of power in Congress.

entry.title: President Trump's widening stamp on D.C. landmarks
entry.summary: NPR's Joel Rose and Rachel Treisman met at East Potomac Golf Links, a golf course that President Trump has ambitions to transform, to discuss the president's widening stamp on D.C. landmarks.

entry.title: Biking along the Great American Rail-Trail
entry.summary: Organizers hope to connect more than 150 existing rail-trails, greenways and other paths spanning more than 3,700 miles across America. NPR's Joel Rose checks on their progress in western Pennsylvania, West Virginia and Ohio.

entry.title: How public bathrooms reflect America's inequality
entry.summary: Public restrooms are scarce in cities across the U.S. It's a topic historian and Temple University professor Bryant Simon writes about in his new book 'For Customers Only: Public Bathrooms and the Making of American Inequality.'

entry.title: Suspect in deadly Oregon elementary school shooting was a former student
entry.summary: Authorities say the 16-year-old suspect in a school shooting that killed three children and one teacher at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon was once a student there.

entry.title: $86m in teen pregnancy prevention funds diverted to Trump-linked contractor
entry.summary: NPR has learned that $86 million in teen pregnancy prevention funds meant for local grantees nationwide is instead going to a single large contractor with ties to the Trump administration.

entry.title: Journalist Ronan Farrow on Elon Musk's trillion-dollar political influence
entry.summary: Elon Musk, the world's first trillionaire, has influence across the economy and politics. NPR's Scott Simon talks to reporter Ronan Farrow of The New Yorker about Musk's campaign spending and more.

entry.title: Meet Catherine Ericson, an official New York leaf peeper in Lake Placid
entry.summary: For the past 10 years, Catherine Ericson has spent her autumns tracking the changing leaves around Lake Placid in upstate New York, as one of the state's official leaf peepers.

entry.title: Trump promised a swing district blitz. He's going to a lot of very red states
entry.summary: President Trump's midterm travel blitz ahead of Election Day includes several red states he won easily 2 years ago, showing the electoral landscape is more challenging for Republicans.
